entries.title: Milestone · Wed Nov 11 (evening)
items: Added crypto strategies 23–26: Crypto momentum burst, Crypto 52-week-high leaders, Crypto squeeze breakout + regime gate, and BTC/ETH weekly momentum + regime gate. Each opened with $10,000 paper at the Nov 10 crypto close.

Picked from 17 crypto strategies backtested on the top 10 coins (SIFT strategy lab run_20261111_crypto) with the same 0.25% costs and five pre-set checks; near-copies of strategies 13, 15, 16 and 22 were left out.
The board and leaderboard are now ranked best to worst by forward return and re-sorted after every daily update, with up/down arrows versus the previous day.
